errors.text_span: Each model category includes a grouped set of three bars representing different SFT training conditions: “no SFT”, “+ SFT on D₀”, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”
errors.evidence: The chart shows four bars per model category, not three.

errors.text_span: The “no SFT” bars are colored blue, reaching approximately 65%, 67%, and 71% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The 7B, 13B, and 70B no-SFT bars are approximately 66.5%, 70%, and 80.5%, not 65%, 67%, and 71%.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange, reaching approximately 67%, 75% and 75% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively.
errors.evidence: The +SFT on D₀ bars are approximately 66.5%, 73.5%, and 81.0%, not 67%, 75%, and 75%.

errors.text_span: The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bars are colored lavender, reaching approximately 74%, 78% and 79% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively
errors.evidence: The +SFT on D₀, D₁ bars are approximately 80.5%, 84.0%, and 83.5%, not 74%, 78%, and 79%.

errors.text_span: the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bars are colored pink and reach approximately 76%, 80% and 80% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively
errors.evidence: The +SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂ bars are approximately 83.5%, 80.0%, and 82.5%, not 76%, 80%, and 80%.

errors.text_span: The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals.
errors.evidence: The y-axis tick labels shown run from 0 up to 80, but the plotted bars extend above 80 to about 84; the description understates the plotted value range by omitting that the bar heights exceed the top labeled tick.
